title: Your First Weekend at Connecticut College, Shared as Cards
description: Navigate your first days as a Camel with this sequence of essential orientation stops, from move-in at Crozier-Williams to the final picnic on Tempel Green.

cards.title: Check-in at Cro
cards.subtitle: Wednesday Morning Arrival
cards.notes: Start your journey at 'Cro' to pick up your room keys and orientation materials. The mailroom is also here if you shipped packages ahead of time.
cards.short_summary: The central hub for move-in day check-in and initial student resources.
cards.evidence_claim: First-year students check in at Crozier-Williams before moving into residence halls, and the mailroom is located on the first floor.
cards.access_notes: Open for check-in during assigned morning time slots (typically 8-11 AM).

cards.title: First Meal at Harris
cards.subtitle: Wednesday Lunch
cards.notes: Head to the Social House at Harris for your first meal on campus. It is the largest dining hall and a primary spot for meeting your new floor mates.
cards.short_summary: The main campus dining hall where students gather for community meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Harris Refectory is the College's largest dining hall and serves as a central location for student meals.
cards.source_title: Financial Aid, Housing, Orientation - Connecticut College
cards.access_notes: Accessible via student Camel Card; check CamelWeb for specific orientation hours.

cards.title: New Student Welcome
cards.subtitle: Wednesday Afternoon
cards.notes: Gather in this historic venue for the official welcome from the Dean of First-Year Students and an overview of your orientation schedule.
cards.short_summary: A major performance venue used for the official orientation welcome ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: New students gather in Palmer Auditorium for a New Student Welcome session on Arrival Day afternoon.
cards.source_title: Conn welcomes Class of 2029 - Connecticut College
cards.access_notes: Mandatory attendance for all new students during the scheduled welcome session.

cards.title: Meet Your Seminar Group
cards.subtitle: Wednesday Late Afternoon
cards.notes: Find your assigned color group on the green to meet your student advisers and first-year seminar peers for the first time.
cards.short_summary: The central campus lawn used for orientation group meetings and social events.
cards.evidence_claim: Students gather with their first-year seminar groups on Tempel Green during orientation.
cards.source_title: Conn welcomes Class of 2029 - Connecticut College
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space; look for student advisers holding color-coded signs.

cards.title: Batch Blast Social
cards.subtitle: Thursday Evening
cards.notes: Enjoy a night of comedy, hypnotists, or live music. This long-standing tradition is designed specifically to help first-years bond.
cards.short_summary: An annual social event for first-year students featuring entertainment and picnics.
cards.evidence_claim: Batch Blast takes place in August for first-year students and includes social events like comedy acts and hypnotists.
cards.access_notes: Exclusive to first-year students as part of Welcome Weekend programming.

cards.title: Explore the Arbo
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning
cards.notes: Take a break from sessions with a walk through the 750-acre 'living laboratory.' The Native Plant Collection is a student favorite for quiet reflection.
cards.short_summary: A vast botanical garden and natural area integrated into the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboretum offers 750 acres of managed landscapes and natural areas for recreation and reflection.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunrise to sunset; main entrance is on Williams Street.

cards.title: Library Tech Tour
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon
cards.notes: Visit the Technology Commons to see the Visualization Wall and find your favorite study nook before classes begin on Tuesday.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus library featuring advanced digital scholarship tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Shain Library features a Technology Commons with a Visualization Wall and is open for student use before classes start.
cards.source_title: Charles E. Shain Library - Connecticut College
cards.access_notes: Open 8:00 AM to midnight on the Monday before classes start; check site for weekend hours.

cards.title: Harkness Chapel Visit
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning
cards.notes: Step inside this colonial-style chapel for a moment of quiet or to appreciate the acoustics. It often hosts student recitals and community events.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus chapel used for religious services and musical performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Harkness Chapel is used for religious services, special events, and musical performances like a cappella concerts.
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled services and public events; check the online calendar for access.

cards.title: New Student Convocation
cards.subtitle: Monday Morning
cards.notes: Join the formal opening of the academic year. This ceremony introduces the Honor Code and officially welcomes you into the Camel community.
cards.short_summary: The formal ceremony marking the beginning of the academic year for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: Convocation celebrates the formal opening of the academic year and welcomes new students, highlighting the Honor Code.
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for all new students; typically held on the Monday before classes begin.

cards.title: All-Campus Picnic
cards.subtitle: Monday Lunch
cards.notes: Celebrate the end of orientation with a community-wide picnic on the green immediately following Convocation. Classes start tomorrow!
cards.short_summary: A celebratory outdoor meal for the entire campus community after Convocation.
cards.evidence_claim: Immediately following Convocation, the campus community gathers for an all-campus picnic.
cards.access_notes: Held on Tempel Green; open to all students, faculty, and staff.
